name: Pelaiah
overview: Pelaiah is identified in Scripture as a son of Elioenai, placing him within a specific genealogical line (1 Chronicles 3:24). He is also noted as a Levite who played an active role alongside Ezra in teaching the people the law, demonstrating his commitment to God's instruction and the spiritual restoration of Israel (Nehemiah 8:7). Additionally, Pelaiah is mentioned among the faithful who renewed their covenant commitments, highlighting his participation in the community's dedication to God's covenant (Nehemiah 10:10).
